import primitive_api as p
p.rotate("left")
for i in range(3):
    print(i, "LOOK:", [(o['objectType'],o['name']) for o in p.detect_objects("BarSoap")] or [o['objectType'] for o in p.detect_objects()])
    if p.detect_objects("BarSoap"): break
    p.rotate("left")
p.look("down")
print("DOWN:", [(o['objectType'],o['name']) for o in p.detect_objects()])
print("PROG:", p.check_progress_public())
